overall_worst.defect: On phone, inline code chips wrap in the middle of a token. "packages/vendure-/plugin/CHANGELOG.md" splits, and "tallyResolveNeedsAdmin(commandId, applied | rejected, note)" breaks into two ragged chips. The changelog and the chip-heavy docs paragraphs look broken at 390 px
overall_worst.fix: Give inline code white-space: nowrap, and allow overflow-wrap: anywhere only for tokens wider than the column. Move long signatures and paths such as tallyResolveNeedsAdmin(...) into fenced code blocks or plain prose
